states.documented: Backed by IOMETE docs, release notes, legal or pricing pages.
states.claimed: IOMETE marketing copy. Quoted with attribution, not verified independently.
states.unknown: Not stated in any public source we could find. Ask IOMETE.

facts.text: IOMETE is software you install on your own Kubernetes, on-premises or in your cloud account. It stores large data cheaply and lets you query it with SQL and Spark.
facts.quote: A sovereign data lakehouse, self-hosted in your trusted environment.

facts.text: Built on Apache Spark for compute and Apache Iceberg for tables, deployed as a Helm chart into Kubernetes.
facts.quote: iomete/iomete-data-plane-enterprise

facts.text: IOMETE does not host your data. The software processes data only inside your environment.
facts.quote: The Software processes Customer Data exclusively within the Customer Environment.
facts.keywords: where does data live stored stay host hosted saas cloud service vendor hold

facts.text: The platform is proprietary, licensed software. It is built on open-source engines but is not itself open source.
facts.quote: LAST UPDATED: MAR 16, 2026
facts.keywords: open source open-source is iomete open source proprietary licence license closed source free software

facts.text: Tables are stored as Apache Iceberg in your object store, so other Iceberg-capable engines can read them if you leave.
facts.quote: BUILT ON OPEN SO
facts.keywords: lock-in leave exit portability migrate away open format

facts.text: Runs on-premises, in public cloud Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE), in private cloud (OpenShift, VMware Tanzu), or hybrid.
facts.quote: Amazon EKS · Azure AKS · Google GKE · OpenShift support · VMware Tanzu
facts.keywords: kubernetes distributions eks aks gke openshift tanzu where run cloud on-prem

facts.text: Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) has its own install guide.
facts.quote: Installing on Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP)?

facts.text: Air-gapped deployment is claimed on the deployment page and FAQ, but no offline install procedure, image list or offline update path is published.
facts.quote: Support for air-gapped environments
facts.keywords: air-gapped airgapped offline disconnected no internet

facts.text: Minimum footprint: 12 CPU cores and 24 GB RAM for IOMETE services, plus at least one 4-core, 32 GB node for Spark.
facts.quote: IOMETE services: at least 12 CPU cores and 24GB of RAM … Spark workloads: at least one node with 4 CPU cores and 32GB of RAM

facts.text: Works with S3, Azure Blob/ADLS, GCS, MinIO, Dell ECS, Ozone, IBM COS and other S3-compatible object stores.
facts.quote: S3-compatible

facts.text: Terraform install is available for Azure only.
facts.quote: currently available for Azure

facts.text: IOMETE says a cloud install takes about 25 minutes (about 15 for Terraform plus 5 for Helm).
facts.quote: a standard deployment takes approximately 25 minutes
facts.keywords: install time how long takes minutes quick deploy duration setup

facts.text: No supported Kubernetes version matrix is published.
Version 4.0.0 (Sep 30, 2026) split a control plane from multiple data planes. An older multi-cluster doc page still says there is no unified control plane.
facts.quote: Calls between a control plane and its data planes are verified with a shared trust secret.

facts.text: Current platform release is 4.0.1 (Oct 8, 2026). Spark images 3.5.7-v7 and the first Spark 4 image, 4.1.3-v1, both shipped Oct 1, 2026.
facts.quote: Platform 4.0.1 (October 8, 2026)
facts.keywords: version latest release current spark iceberg

facts.text: Compute clusters expose HiveServer2 (JDBC/ODBC), Spark Connect and Arrow Flight endpoints.
facts.quote: HiveServer2 JDBC … Spark Connect … Arrow Flight

facts.text: Includes compute clusters, a SQL editor, Spark jobs with an orchestrator, Jupyter containers, a data catalog, data security policies and event streams.
facts.quote: Data Lakehouse(s), Data Catalog, SQL Editor, Advanced Data Controls, Spark Jobs, ML Notebooks, Spark Connect, Orchestration Engine

facts.text: Integrations: dbt (dbt-iomete adapter), Airflow plugin, Power BI and Tableau connectors, JDBC/ODBC drivers.
facts.quote: dbt-iomete | 1.8.3

facts.text: An MCP server for AI agents is available in beta.
facts.quote: MCP Server for AI Agents

facts.text: Automated Iceberg table maintenance is in beta and works only for some catalog types.
facts.quote: Not every catalog supports automated maintenance

facts.text: Data lineage is not shipped. It sits in the roadmap backlog, although homepage copy mentions lineage.
facts.quote: Data Lineage Backlog
facts.keywords: lineage data lineage provenance

facts.text: No IOMETE command-line tool is documented.
IOMETE University offers 9 free videos in 3 modules: compute clusters, connections and troubleshooting, and Apache Iceberg.
Single sign-on via SAML 2.0 and OIDC (Okta, OneLogin, Microsoft Entra ID), SCIM provisioning, and LDAP / Active Directory sync.
facts.quote: local credentials, LDAP directory sync, or federated identity via SAML/OIDC (Okta, OneLogin, Microsoft Entra ID, SCIM provisioning)
facts.keywords: sso okta entra azure ad active directory saml oidc ldap scim login

facts.text: Multi-factor authentication is delegated to your identity provider. IOMETE does not enforce it itself.
facts.quote: you can enable fine-grained access control, such as multi-factor authentication, via your identity provider
facts.keywords: mfa 2fa multi-factor two-factor

facts.text: Seven masking types (redact, hash, null, show last 4, show first 4, year only, custom SQL) applied dynamically in query results.
facts.quote: Mask Show Last 4 -- Show only the last four characters. - Mask Show First 4 -- Show only the first four characters. - Mask Hash

facts.text: Resource-based and tag-based access policies over databases, tables and columns, plus row filters and data masking.
facts.quote: IOMETE has two types of policies: resource-based and tag-based.

facts.text: Audit events and data-access decisions are written to Iceberg system tables (platform_event_logs, data_access_audit).
facts.quote: stores all platform audit events

facts.text: Ships Kubernetes NetworkPolicies that restrict traffic between IOMETE namespaces and Jupyter containers.
facts.quote: using the label `iomete.com/managed: "true"`

facts.text: Platform secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM since v4.0.0, with optional HashiCorp Vault.
facts.quote: encrypted with AES-256-GCM and scoped per domain

facts.text: Encryption of the data itself is your object store's and key manager's job. IOMETE does not hold your encryption keys.
facts.quote: does not hold or manage your encryption keys
facts.keywords: encrypt encrypted encryption at rest kms keys byok own keys

facts.text: Release notes record repeated CVE fixes, most recently in v4.0.0 and v4.0.1.
facts.quote: Resolved critical and high-severity CVEs in the backend services

facts.text: SOC 2 Type I report, December 2022, audited by Prescient Assurance. The homepage shows a "SOC2 Certified" badge without stating the type.
facts.quote: achieved SOC 2 Type I compliance
facts.keywords: soc 2 soc2 type i type 1 report certified

facts.text: The homepage shows HIPAA Compliant and GDPR Compliant badges with no stated scope or assessor.
facts.quote: SOC2 Certified · HIPAA Compliant · GDPR Compliant
facts.keywords: hipaa gdpr compliant badge

facts.text: A Vanta-hosted trust center exists. Its contents must be read there directly.
The licence lets IOMETE collect usage data such as logs, telemetry and performance metrics, excluding customer data. So "nothing phones home" cannot be assumed.
facts.quote: IOMETE may collect and use Usage Data … logs, telemetry, performance metrics, and metadata
facts.keywords: phone home telemetry usage data call home metrics collect

facts.text: IOMETE staff access customer data only when a statement of work authorises it, read-only, using credentials the customer controls.
facts.quote: IOMETE will only access Customer Data when such access is specifically authorized in the applicable SOW
facts.keywords: staff access see our data vendor access support engineer

facts.text: Free plan: no licence cost, up to 100 vCPUs, core features, community support. Access is reviewed manually.
facts.quote: Zero · Max 100 vCPUs
facts.keywords: free tier community edition trial try

facts.text: Enterprise: $500 per vCPU per year, with a $100,000 per year minimum (200 vCPUs). Adds data masking, row-level security, auditing and enterprise support.
facts.quote: $500 license cost per vCPU per year · $100,000 per year (200 vCPU) minimum commitment
facts.keywords: enterprise cost price how much licence minimum contract commitment annual

facts.text: Business Critical: custom price, $250,000 per year minimum, adds multi-region and dedicated engineers.
facts.quote: $250,000 per year minimum commitment

facts.text: The $500 per vCPU per year is the software licence only. Your own cloud or hardware costs come on top.
facts.quote: IOMETE charges $500 per vCPU per year for software licensing. That's it.

facts.text: IOMETE says there are no per-query or per-user fees.
facts.quote: there are no per-query or per-user fees

facts.text: Support tiers Silver, Gold and Platinum publish Sev-1 response targets of 1 hour, 1 hour and 30 minutes. Gold's was relaxed from 30 minutes to 1 hour in 2026.
facts.quote: SLA response times SEV 1 1 hour
facts.keywords: support sla response time severity sev1 silver gold platinum

facts.text: Support tier prices, onboarding and professional services rates, and volume discounts are not published.
facts.keywords: support price support cost support tier support plan silver gold platinum onboarding professional services discount how much

facts.text: No AWS, Azure or Google Cloud marketplace listing was found.
facts.keywords: aws marketplace azure marketplace gcp marketplace buy through

facts.text: IOMETE's savings claims differ by page: "2-5x" on the homepage, "30-60%" in the FAQ, "40-60% lower TCO" on the blog. One of its own worked examples shows about a 1% saving.
facts.quote: Save 2-5x over SaaS/cloud.
facts.keywords: cheaper savings save tco roi compared databricks snowflake

facts.text: The pricing model has changed three times since 2023: per core per month, then per vCPU-hour, then the current per vCPU per year.

facts.text: SAP acquired Dremio, announced May 2026 and closed in July 2026. IOMETE publishes a Dremio migration guide.
